{{Quote|I'm Ensign Tholver Shan, Imperial Military Operating Number 218A697. Please--did the Duchess send you? Please help me.|Tholver Shan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Tholver Shan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as an [[ensign]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarnova]], who he and others who served under her referred to as "[[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]]."

Shan was sent into the [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] of the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on assignment with the rest of his squad. However, he and his squadmates were captured by Grathan's forces. The Sith Lord then used them in his experiments to create the ultimate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army. He removed their brains and, through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], placed them into the bodies of [[OHK-99]] droids which the Sith lord could control via override. An individual working for the Sith Empire broke into Lord Grathan's laboratory and was faced with the option of shutting them down, thereby saving them from their living nightmare, or reprogramming them to obey the Empire.
